label: Teltonika TRB501 5G IoT gateway with eSIM
description: Industrial 5G gateway, 3GPP Rel.16 sub-6 at 2.4 Gbps downlink in SA and 3.4 Gbps in NSA, with eSIM plus bootstrap so a profile can be pulled over the air before an Ethernet WAN exists. One 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet LAN port; the 5G uplink is carried as the Ethernet-class interface wan5g.
